# Proof & Realness

Legend: [D] demonstrated · [A] anticipated · [T] target.

- [D] The board was actually pruned to roughly twelve pink milestones, counted aloud: "one two three four six seven eight nine ten eleven twelve okay we kind of got 12 there."
- [D] The discarded work is preserved as evidence: "we've got a recording and a picture of it"; photos taken "at each major rearrange."
- [A] Trust Graph launch in August, with "visualizations" and "marketing" "before it's... effective" (asserted, not yet shown; unverified within the transcript).
- [A] "Anthropic" pledging "42 billion tokens" scaling with membership; "4.2 million tokens for all humans" (aspiration, no commitment shown; unverified).
- [T] "142, or half of 42 partners" signed at a Davos-style event.
- [T] The Dolphin Fund "established before the agm," launched at the AGM (~March 2027).
- [T] July 4th 2028 AGM as the terminal milestone.

**Headline metric.** Number of signed partners against the explicit target ("complete our target of 142 partners"), the one figure they said they must "specify the number" for.
